naslov: Daniel Hackett among additions to EuroLeague Round 11 injury report
tekst:
Olympiacos Piraeus vs. Dubai Basketball (20:15 CET)
Olympiacos
Olympiacos will be without Tyler Dorsey and Jean Montero for its game against Dubai, the club has confirmed.
- New signing John Konchar made his debut in Round 10.
- Tyler Dorsey last played in Round 5 after being suspended by the club.
- Jean Montero last played in Round 6. He is ruled out for six months after knee surgery, the club announced on October 30.
